Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Observability team's mission is to build and own Robinhood's full-stack observability platform — the foundation that keeps every product, service, and customer experience running reliably at scale. We design and operate the systems that give engineers deep visibility into how Robinhood's infrastructure behaves, ensuring that when something goes wrong, the right people know immediately and can act fast. Our work spans metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and alerting pipelines, and we partner closely with the Robinhood Command Center to ensure our observability systems meet or exceed 99.9% uptime. We believe in monitoring our own monitors — the observability infrastructure is a product, not just a tool.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you will be the technical lead shaping the roadmap for how Robinhood observes itself at scale. You will own the observability control plane end-to-end, making architectural decisions that directly impact the reliability and operational health of Robinhood's entire product surface. You'll lead a team of six engineers, drive the strategy for cost-efficient telemetry ingestion, build in-house solutions where off-the-shelf tooling falls short, and integrate AI-driven approaches to accelerate progress toward full-stack observability. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role where your technical decisions set the direction for the entire organization!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

  • Define and execute the full-stack observability roadmap, establishing a clear technical vision for metrics, logs, traces, and alerting infrastructure across Robinhood's engineering organization.
  • Own and evolve the observability control plane, including telemetry ingestion pipelines, cost management strategies, and the tooling that ensures observability components remain highly available.
  • Lead and collaborate with a team of six engineers to build scalable, self-service observability solutions that enable product and infrastructure teams to move faster with greater confidence.
  • Establish and maintain SLOs for observability systems that meet or exceed Robinhood's 99.9% uptime target, ensuring the observability platform is as reliable as the services it monitors.
  • Partner with the Robinhood Command Center and engineering teams across the organization to align on dependency mapping, incident response workflows, and observability standards.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of owning and delivering large-scale observability or infrastructure platform initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and public cloud environments (AWS preferred), with the ability to architect and operate distributed systems at scale regardless of specific vendor tooling.
  • Strong coding proficiency in one or more languages (Go, Python, or similar) with experience integrating observability agents, libraries, and instrumentation directly into production codebases.
  • Demonstrated experience owning an observability control plane or telemetry pipeline — including ingestion cost management, cardinality control, and signal routing — in a high-traffic production environment.
  • Experience with the Vector data pipeline (or equivalent high-throughput log/metrics routing tools) and familiarity with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb, Humio, or Sentry is a plus.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

The VIP Growth Manager will serve as a central strategy and operations partner for the VIP business. Through data analysis, user insights, and cross-functional collaboration, this role will support VIP Relationship Managers and regional teams with growth strategies and initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical thinking and communication skills, with the ability to identify growth opportunities from user behavior and business data, translate insights into actionable plans, and collaborate with relevant teams to drive execution and continuous optimization.
 
VIP增长经理将作为VIP业务的核心策略与运营伙伴，通过数据分析、用户洞察及跨部门协作，为VIP客户关系经理（RM）及各区域团队提供增长策略与项目支持。
我们希望候选人具备较强的分析思维和沟通能力，能够从用户行为及业务数据中识别增长机会，将洞察转化为可执行的业务方案，并协同相关团队推动落地和持续优化。
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Business Insights & Strategy
  • Identify structural problems and opportunities in the data, such as churn signals among high-value users, differences in service needs across client segments, and the marginal return on resource allocation, and turn them into actionable strategies.
  • Write business insight reports for senior management that shape VIP benefits, resource allocation, and team playbooks.
Data Monitoring
  • Build and maintain the VIP core metrics framework with daily monitoring; when a metric moves unexpectedly, find the root cause and recommend actionable next steps.
  • Automate recurring analyses and reports as dashboards or scheduled jobs (for example weekly and monthly reports, incentive plan results, and anomaly alerts) to reduce repetitive manual data pulls.
  • Work with the Data Warehouse and BI teams to standardize metric definitions and build data tables, so the data stays accurate and traceable.
Incentive Plan Design & Execution
  • Design and strategise incentive plans for VIP business teams, covering metric selection, target breakdown, weighting, and payout linkage.
  • Track how the incentive plans are carried out, deliver results weekly and monthly, and update the plan criteria as the business changes (for example VIP tier threshold adjustments or new market launches).
Middle Office Capability Building & Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Document SOPs, metric definitions, and methods for VIP growth, and drive alignment and reuse across regions.
  • Act as the middle office hub between RM teams, regional markets, Product, Risk, and Finance, taking strategies through its entire lifecycle.
  • Gather feedback from frontline teams and users, combine it with business data to find common needs, and help improve the product experience, service processes, and operating tools.

业务洞察与策略制定

  • 从数据中识别结构性问题及业务机会，例如高价值用户的流失信号、不同客户群体的服务需求差异，以及资源投入的边际回报等，并将分析结果转化为可执行的业务策略。
  • 面向管理层撰写业务洞察报告，为VIP权益设计、资源配置及团队业务打法提供决策依据。

数据监控与分析

  • 搭建并持续维护VIP业务核心指标体系，进行日常数据监控；针对指标异常波动及时定位根因，并提出明确、可执行的后续建议。
  • 将周期性分析及报告自动化，通过数据看板或定时任务完成周报、月报、激励方案结果分析及异常预警等工作，减少重复性人工取数。
  • 与数据仓库及商业智能团队协作，统一指标定义并建设相关数据表，确保数据准确、口径一致且全程可追溯。

激励方案设计与落地

  • 负责VIP业务团队激励方案的设计与策略制定，包括指标选择、目标拆解、权重设置及激励结果挂钩机制。
  • 跟踪激励方案的执行情况，按周、按月输出结果，并结合业务变化持续调整方案标准，例如VIP等级门槛调整或新市场上线等。

中台能力建设与跨部门协作

  • 沉淀VIP增长相关的标准操作流程、指标口径及工作方法，推动不同区域之间统一认知、共享经验并复用成熟打法。
  • 作为连接客户关系经理团队、区域市场、产品、风险及财务等团队的中台枢纽，推动业务策略从制定到落地的全流程闭环。
  • 收集一线团队及用户反馈，结合业务数据识别共性需求，协助优化产品体验、服务流程及运营工具。
 

What We Look For In You

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 3–5 years of experience in user growth, strategy operations, business analytics, client operations, or a related field.
  2. Strong data analysis skills; proficient in SQL and able to pull and analyze data independently.
  3. Insight is the core requirement: able to find the key issue in the data, tell correlation from causation, and reach clear conclusions with deliberate trade-offs, rather than simply listing numbers.
  4. Structured thinker with strong business sense; able to break ambiguous business problems into analytical frameworks and turn them into operational actions.
  5. Strong drive to get things done and good at cross-team communication; able to win business stakeholders over to insights and drive execution.
  6. Experience using AI tools to improve analysis and productivity is a plus.
  7. Fluent in written and spoken English and Chinese; Chinese is used as a working language.

  2. 具备较强的数据分析能力，熟练使用SQL，能够独立完成数据提取与分析。
  3. 业务洞察能力是本岗位的核心要求：能够从数据中识别关键问题，区分相关关系与因果关系，并在充分权衡的基础上得出清晰结论，而非简单罗列数据。

Perks & Benefits

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are domain experts aligned to Stripe’s solutions and the customer buying centers they serve. We combine deep product and industry expertise with an understanding of our customers’ most complex business and technical challenges.

The SSA team partners with specialist sellers and the broader pre-sales organization to shape strategic opportunities, develop pipeline, improve revenue attainment, and turn Stripe’s product capabilities into measurable customer outcomes. We also bring field insights to Product and Engineering, helping influence Stripe’s roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

Stripe's Revenue Suite helps businesses monetize however their customers want to buy: subscription, usage-based, or hybrid pricing. As monetization models get more complex and pricing becomes something companies iterate on continuously rather than set once, this team sits at the center of how Stripe helps businesses price, bill, recognize, and report on revenue.

What you’ll do

As Global Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture for Revenue, you will lead the global strategy, execution, and growth of the SSA organization supporting Stripe's full Revenue Suite: Stripe Billing and Metronome together. You will define how Stripe engages customers across the entire monetization-to-revenue-reporting lifecycle, including subscription management, usage-based and hybrid billing, invoicing, tax, revenue recognition, and analytics, from initial business and technical discovery through solution design, adoption, value realization, and expansion.

This is a second line leadership role. You will manage a mix of regional managers, each leading their own team of specialist architects, along with a small number of senior individual contributors reporting to you directly. You will build and develop this multi-layered organization and create the operating model, playbooks, and cross-functional partnerships needed to scale it worldwide. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Engineering, you will help customers modernize their revenue infrastructure while accelerating adoption and growth for Stripe's Revenue Suite across every region we operate in.

This is an opportunity to shape a global function at an important point in Stripe's expansion beyond payments. You will connect deep technical expertise to customer value and commercial outcomes while ensuring that customer needs from every region influence Stripe's global product and go-to-market direction.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the global technical sales strategy for Stripe's Revenue Suite, aligning specialist coverage, priorities, and investments with growth opportunities across AMER, EMEA, and APAC
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of regional managers and senior individual contributors, establishing clear expectations for technical excellence, customer impact, and commercial contribution
  • Coach and develop your managers directly, building their leadership capability so they can in turn grow strong specialist architects on their own teams
  • Partner with Sales leadership to prioritize resources, shape account strategies, and improve the progression and conversion of complex opportunities
  • Establish repeatable engagement models, playbooks, reference architectures, and execution standards across the monetization-to-revenue-reporting lifecycle, including subscription management, usage-based and hybrid billing, invoicing, tax, revenue recognition, and analytics
  • Advise executives, developers, architects, finance leaders, and other decision-makers on modernizing their monetization and revenue-management architectures
  • Guide strategic customers from business and technical discovery through solution design, validation, adoption, value realization, and expansion
  • Translate recurring customer needs, market signals, and deal friction into actionable insights that influence Product and Engineering priorities
  • Represent the Revenue SSA organization in global leadership forums, providing clear perspectives on performance, capacity, risks, customer needs, and growth opportunities
  • Shape the Revenue Suite go-to-market approach across every region, accounting for regional regulatory requirements, business models, and market-specific billing practices
  • Build strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing mechanisms across regional and global teams to improve consistency, reuse, and execution quality
  • Advance Stripe's external thought leadership through executive briefings, industry events, white papers, and reference architectures focused on billing, monetization, tax automation, and revenue management

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions architecture, solution consulting, or another customer-facing technical role in enterprise technology
  • 10+ years of experience building and scaling pre-sales or solutions architecture teams, including hiring, managing, coaching, and developing senior individual contributors 
  • Experience managing managers, with a track record of developing people leaders and running a multi-layered organization
  • Demonstrated success partnering with sales leaders on complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities and connecting technical strategy to commercial outcomes
  • Deep understanding of modern monetization models, including subscription, usage-based, and hybrid pricing, and how businesses increasingly treat pricing as something to iterate on continuously rather than set once, and how that shapes billing, invoicing, and revenue-management requirements
  • Strong technical background with a solid understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and modern software development practices
  • Experience operating across global markets, with an ability to adapt leadership and go-to-market approaches across different regions and cultures
  • Strong executive communication, relationship-building, and cross-functional leadership skills
  • Ability to communicate complex business and technical concepts clearly to audiences ranging from developers and architects to finance leaders and C-level executives
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time

Preferred qualifications

  • Working knowledge of the full revenue management lifecycle: recurring and usage-based billing, subscription management, invoicing, tax automation (sales tax and VAT), revenue recognition, financial/custom reporting, and the data pipelines that feed them
  • Experience designing or advising on complex enterprise architectures and integrations involving financial or revenue-management systems, including configure-price-quote, order-to-cash, revenue recognition, and ERP systems
  • Experience with usage-based or consumption billing platforms and the metering, pricing, and invoicing architectures they require
  • Experience building or scaling a global technical go-to-market function during a period of rapid product or organizational growth
  • A track record of translating field insights into meaningful product, engineering, or go-to-market changes
  • Experience developing executive-facing thought leadership, reference architectures, or industry-specific solution strategies
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and commercial considerations that affect billing, tax, and revenue management across AMER, EMEA, and APAC

descriptions.job-1c0lwpg:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Strategic Finance Lead, GTM, you will play a critical role in shaping TRM’s financial trajectory by driving rigorous planning, analysis, and reporting with a primary focus on supporting GTM strategy and execution. Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you’ll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to deliver insights that help TRM scale efficiently and strategically. You’ll lead core FP&A rhythms — including forecasting, reporting, and long-range planning — while building dynamic models and crafting clear, compelling narratives for executives, the board, and investors. This role is a strong fit for an analytically rigorous, detail-oriented finance athlete who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys solving complex problems collaboratively.

Strategic Finance at TRM is still early — you will shape not just the business, but also the team and culture as we build a world-class function. This role is an exceptional launch pad for an ambitious finance professional seeking outsized impact, close mentorship, and accelerated growth.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead monthly and quarterly forecasting and reporting rhythms, with deep ownership of GTM forecasts (bookings, ARR, pipeline, and headcount), partnering closely with the Head of Strategic Finance

  • Own budget-vs-actuals updates for GTM functions, identifying variances across sales capacity, marketing spend, and customer acquisition metrics

  • Develop board-ready materials and compelling financial narratives related to growth performance, efficiency, and ROI for executive reviews and company all-hands meetings

  • Support comprehensive top-down and bottom-up financial planning for 2026 and beyond, including sales capacity modeling, quota planning, and growth scenarios

  • Build models and templates to inform GTM investment decisions, including hiring, target setting, and marketing mix

  • Drive strategic projects — including pricing and packaging, sales compensation economics, vendor optimization, ROI analysis, and more

  • Assist with investor reporting and fundraising, articulating TRM’s GTM strategy, unit economics, and path to efficient scale, with a path toward increasing ownership and responsibility

What we’re looking for:

  • 4–7 years of experience across investment banking, investing, consulting, or finance at a high-growth tech company

  • Experience supporting revenue-driving or customer-facing teams (Sales, Marketing, RevOps, or CS) strongly preferred

  • Expert-level Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills

  • Clarity and polish in writing and presentations

  • Experience with planning cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual)

  • Comfort with working independently and proactively driving outcomes

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration preferred; MBA a plus

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. Recruitment agencies

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and their money should move with them. Every product, corridor and payment rail we add opens a new door for fraudsters. We want to be the least attractive target on our corridors, without adding friction for good customers. This role exists to own how we detect and deter fraud across every rail and geo.

You’ll lead fraud detection and deterrence end to end, from exposure mapping to rules, limits and customer protection. You report to our Head of Financial Crime and work alongside the fraud recovery and chargebacks lead. You partner with Product, Payments, Engineering, Customer Support and Compliance on every launch. You decide what ships on day one, and you own the trade-off between fraud caught and friction added.

Who You Are

You don’t see fraud as a dashboard to watch. You see it as a live contest, won or lost in seconds, and you’ve been in it.

  • You’ve done multiple rodeos. You’ve worked fraud at more than one fintech or high-velocity regulated platform across the UK, EU or US. That could be a neobank, payments company, gambling operator, gaming platform or crypto exchange. You know how attacks, rails and rules differ in each.

  • You’ve built controls from scratch. At a B2C fintech, you built fraud controls that didn’t exist before, while protecting consumer money at scale.

  • You’ve worked the floor. You started as an investigator and worked alerts and cases by hand. You spot a pattern before it shows on a dashboard.

  • You’ve been baptised by fire. You’ve handled a real fraud attack or loss spike and made fast calls under pressure. You stayed on it until the fix held, and learned from every case.

  • You own the approach. You decide how to tackle a problem and see it through end to end, without waiting to be told.

  • You see every launch as a new door. You map where fraud can get in before go-live, not after the first losses land.

  • You protect good customers too. You stop fraud without adding friction for the people we serve, and you can show the numbers behind it.

Most importantly, you’d rather build the right controls once, on our own decisioning platform, than tune vendor defaults forever.

What You’ll Own

This is a role with a mandate across every rail, product and geo we operate in.

  • See the exposure, everywhere. Map where fraud can hit us on every rail, product and geo, and own the observability layer that lets us watch it live.

  • Build rules that hold. Stand up rule building and governance on our decisioning platform, with every change back-tested before it ships.

  • Tier exposure by risk. Design progressive access to payment rails by risk tier, so trusted customers move freely and limits grow with trust.

  • Measure every trade-off. Track each control change in fraud caught against friction added, and retire the rules that no longer earn their place.

  • Protect customers in the moment. Put vulnerable-customer education and in-the-moment verification on every rail, without slowing good customers down.

  • Launch with controls from day one. Make sure every new product, geo or rail has a signed-off exposure map before it goes live.

Your calls will shape how fast Aspora can open new corridors, and how safely customers move money once we’re there.

Why Aspora

  • Define how Aspora detects and deters fraud across every rail and geo, and set the playbook every launch follows.

  • Work directly with our Head of Financial Crime, and partner with Product, Payments and Engineering on every launch.

  • Build controls on our own decisioning platform, across high-volume cross-border flows at significant scale.

  • Own fraud strategy from day one, from exposure mapping through to customer protection.

  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

About the role

As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.


As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.


What you’ll do

  • Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.
  • Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.
  • Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.
  • Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.
  • Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.
  • Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.
  • Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle’s fraud platform.
  • Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime
  • Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar
  • Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag
  • Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization
  • Experience taking models to production and monitoring them
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

  • Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes
  • Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC
  • Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows

Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.
